method: Summon • Demon Parade • Wanted Quests • Dispatch

skills.name: Heart Strike (心斩/心剣)
skills.line: My heart's wish is my blade's command. En garde!
skills.description: Inugami's heart becomes one with his sword as he wields it against a single target, dealing damage to equal 100% of his ATK.

skills.name: Protection (守护/守護)
skills.line: My friend, I'm here to protect you!
skills.description:
Exclusive effect.
At the start of battle and at the end of Inugami's turn, he grants half of his allies with a Protection Mark. Allies with the lowest proportion of HP, rounded down, are prioritized.
When a counter-attack triggered by Protection Mark is launched, his ATK is increased by 30% of the counter-attacked enemy's ATK (cannot exceed 210% of Inugami's base ATK), lasts until the end of Inugami's next turn.
When counter-attacking, Inugami also inflicts the enemy with Tailed, lasts for 1 turn. If 2 or more enemies have Tailed, the onibi cost for Sword Flurry is decreased by 2. ;Upon Usage :Inugami grants Best Friend to 1 ally, sustained for 1 turn. When an ally with Best Friend is KO'd, removes all control effects on Inugami, increases his move bar by 30%, and changes this skill to Best Friend's Rage. He also creates a shield to protect himself that can absorb damage equal to 100% of his ATK, and a shield for all other allies that can absorb damage equal to 30% of his ATK, both last 1 turn. ;Protection Mark (守護の印) :'''Common, Mark''': When an ally receives non-transferred damage, Inugami launches a counter-attack against the source of the damage, dealing damage equal to 110% of his ATK. :''(A paw print will circle around protected allies.)'' ;Tailed (凝視) : :'''Debuff, Mark''': Decreases ATK by 35%. ;Buddy! (友よ！) : :'''General, Mark''': Inugami's best friend. He will become enraged when his best friend is KO'd.

skills.name: Best Friend's Rage (親友の怒り)
skills.description:
Inugami's base ATK is increased by 210% and he grants Protection Mark to all allies.
Whenever a Protection Mark triggers a counter attack, recovers his own HP by 15% of the damage dealt; if Inugami is Immobile, dispels 1 control effect or debuff on him instead.
Sword Flurry's damage dealt no longer decreased when attacking the same enemy and its cost is decreased by 2 onibi. Before Inugami's next turn, each 1 new ally KO'd allows his next Sword Flurry to inflict 1 additional follow-up strike.

skills.name: Sword Flurry (心剑乱舞/心剣乱舞)
skills.line: My heart and my sword are united!
skills.description:
Inugami rushes about, unleashing a flurry of 5 blows on all enemies, prioritising enemies who haven't been attacked, dealing damage equal to 92% of his ATK with each blow.
Damage is decreased by 50% for each blow on the same enemy.

bio.condition: With Inugami win 5 times in against Kyuumei Neko.
